opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions in the UK undertaking internationally competitive research.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research infrastructure, and occasionally to improve access and research libraries or public engagement with science.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Maximum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £50,000 (equipment), £15,000 – £100,000 (new build and refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: State-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges in the UK with at least two years of exam results and an Ofsted/Estyn/HMIE/ETI rating of 'Good' or above.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to high-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges for new build, refurbishment and technical equipment to improve teaching of specialist subjects (science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music, performing arts) at GCSE and A-Level. One-stage application process. 2026 round closed; next round expected spring 2027.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK; if applicable should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment supporting pupils at secondary level to gain employment or live independently.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority in the UK; if applicable should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to organisations working with disability, helping people live more independently, with particular interest in training, employment and supported housing, especially for young people transitioning from children's to adults' services.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority in the UK; if applicable should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to charities working in mental health, with emphasis on projects focusing on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority in the UK; if applicable should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to organisations providing care and services for older people, particularly those with a neurodegenerative condition or who are isolated, towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK managing sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance that are open and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance. Also covers places of worship of other faiths and cathedrals.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS in the UK; if applicable should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to hospices and palliative care organisations providing excellent care to patients and their families, towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK, fully accredited under the Archive Service Accreditation Scheme, holding a permanent collection of national significance and open to the public.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections, usually for collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme, holding a permanent collection of national significance.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to museums and galleries to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections for the public, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and occasionally education and learning spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK focused on professional performance, where the performing arts constitute the vast majority of its activities.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to performing arts organisations to improve their training and education facilities, generally towards building or refurbishment of these facilities and occasionally specialist equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university in the UK displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to organisations with significant scientific or natural history collections to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and occasionally education and learning spaces.
